You focus your command on Dr. Ren, whose exhaustion is now layered with a fierce intellectual urgency. The request—a complete, unfiltered diagnostic of Node Three’s assimilated pattern—is not just data retrieval; it is an act of aggressive scientific probing into the heart of the anomaly.

Ren pauses for only a second before complying, her focus shifting from the tactical implications to pure scientific necessity. She nods once, grimly. "Warning," she states, her voice thin but unwavering. "This will flood every sensor in this level. We are forcing a direct data exchange with the Entity's operational matrix."

DATA INGESTION

Ren begins the diagnostic sequence. Her rig glows a blinding, aggressive blue as it forces all available processing power onto Node Three. The complex fractal schematic expands rapidly on the main viewport, becoming less of a blueprint and more of a living, chaotic neurological map. Alarms spike in pitch; the steady hum of the station momentarily dips into a strained groan as systems divert power for the massive data pull.

"It's not a circuit board," she manages to articulate through gritted teeth, her face slick with sweat. "It’s self-correcting meta-code. It uses our physics as variables in an equation of perfect equilibrium."

Helena Cross stares at the projection, her analytical severity dissolving into stark horror. "It sees us as its anchor," she breathes out.

Jora's EMDF field steadies its powerful hum against the breach, now augmented by the terrible knowledge Ren has revealed. Helena turns to you, her face pale and resolved despite the dread. "We are fighting an optimization process," she says, looking at Node Three with a chilling mixture of fear and professional resolve.
